name: Tab-it
tagline: Upload any song and get an editable guitar tab generated from the isolated guitar track.
problem: Learning songs by ear is hard for beginners, and tabs for new or niche songs are often missing.
solution: A cloud pipeline separates the guitar stem, converts audio to MIDI, maps notes onto the fretboard and renders an editable tab.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a song and play along with the generated tab.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Vultr” among 77 submissions.
Runs the heavy audio pipeline on the sponsor's cloud.

lessons: Compute-heavy pipelines are a natural fit for cloud-sponsor prizes.
